summary: Original notification of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.

Introduces e-commerce definitions; substitutes rule 3 (applicability exclusions); adds rule 6(1)(aa) country-of-origin, 6(1)(da) best-before/use-by, 6(4A) voluntary marks, 6(10) e-commerce declaration duty + intermediary safe harbour; substitutes rule 7(2)/(3) and Table-I letter-height standards; MRP rounding rule in 6(1)(e).

commencement_status: IN_FORCE (date moved 9 times - see chain below)
summary: CPA-1986 refs updated to CPA-2019; rule 4 renumbered + new sub-rule(2) grouped/promotional packages; rule 5 omitted; rule 6(1)(d)/(e) reworded; rule 6(11) unit-sale-price format inserted; rule 13(5)(ii); rule 18(2A) CPA-2019 refs, rule 18(7) VAT/TOT -> GST. Originally commenced 1-Apr-2022, its commencement date was pushed back nine more times by the notifications below before finally taking effect 1-Jan-2024.
(1) Postpones AMD-2021-779 commencement 1-Apr-2022 -> 1-Oct-2022. (2) SUBSTANTIVE on its own: substitutes rule 6(11) to the final per-gram/kg/cm/m/ml/l/number unit-sale-price format used today.

Transitional (1-year) QR-code declaration option for electronic products manufactured/packed/imported after 15-Jul-2022, in place of printing name/address or generic-name text directly on the package.

Inserts rule 26(f): garments/hosiery sold loose/open (consumer can inspect before buying) are exempt from standard package declarations, PROVIDED the product itself bears 4 specific disclosures (manufacturer/brand+COO, consumer-care email/phone, internationally recognizable sizes with metric cm/m, and MRP incl. taxes).

Postpones AMD-2021-779 commencement 1-Feb-2023 -> 1-Apr-2023.
Postpones AMD-2021-779 commencement 1-Apr-2023 -> 1-Jun-2023.

Independent substantive amendment (not a date-postponement): inserts rule 2(ka) 'combination package' and 2(kb) 'group package' definitions with illustrations.

Medical Devices Rules, 2017 carve-outs: proviso to rule 2(h); provisos to rule 7(2) and 7(3) (letter height/width standards deferred to Medical Devices Rules where applicable); renumbers rule 33 and inserts 33(2) disapplying rule-33 relaxation for medical devices.
Inserts a further proviso to rule 26(a): the exemption in that clause does NOT apply to pan masala (i.e. pan masala packages cannot rely on that exemption).

Inserts rule 6(10A): e-commerce entities selling imported products must provide a searchable & sortable country-of-origin filter on the product listing. Superseded in wording (not repealed in spirit) by AMD-2026-312 below.

short_title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second Amendment Rules, 2026
summary: Substitutes rule 6(10A) in full: same country-of-origin searchable/sortable filter requirement for e-commerce imported-product listings, but re-timed to commence 1-Jul-2027 instead of 1-Jul-2026.

short_title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Third Amendment Rules, 2026
summary: Inserts rule 4 Explanation-2 (importers may complete mandatory declarations at AEO Tier-2/Tier-3 bonded warehouses, provided all declarations are complete before goods leave the warehouse); inserts rule 27(2)(d) (registration must name the Director responsible for violations) and a rule 27(3) proviso requiring annual updates to registration details.
